entries.The maker’s mark is strange to me. We ha: The maker’s mark is strange to me. We had best consult Lord Hamel.
entries.And for what cause ha’ I heard naught o’: And for what cause ha’ I heard nought o’ this?
entries.Angarthing, Aiglondur, and the dwarvish: Angarthing, Aiglondur, and the dwarvish troop travelled swiftly to the east through the settled lands of the Northern Alliance. Soon enough they came to the wilder march country, where raids by large bands of hostile orcs and men were all too common.
Well, then, honour the treaty as I have. Fight to repel these invaders.
entries.I hear the howling of wolves, and the sh: I hear the howling of wolves, and the shrill cries of gryphons. Travelling here may prove dangerous.
entries.To capture a gryphon, injure it below 10: To capture a gryphon, injure it below 10 hit-points without killing it.
entries.It is an honor to travel alongside a lor: It is an honour to travel alongside a loremaster, Angarthing. One cannot begin to fathom the secrets of your order.
entries.I keep the Law. I witness the Deeds. Act: I keep the Law. I witness the Deeds. Act with honour, Aiglondur.
entries.Our fire magic is useless against those: Our fire magic is useless against those fire-breathing monsters. Our camp is not far from here, to the north-east.
entries.Northeast is the way we are traveling. A: North-east is the way we are travelling. And I’d not leave anyone who needs our help stranded to burn. Lead the way.
entries.A delegation of the Northern Alliance, t: A delegation of the Northern Alliance, travelling east. I believe we’ve found a friend of yours in the High Pass.
entries.Unfortunately, they’ve proven uncooperat: Unfortunately, they’ve proven unco-operative. The brutes attacked us several times, and show no sign of stopping. I fear that they mean to kill us all!
entries.Does it matter? He is only a dirtgrubbin: Does it matter? He is only a dirt-grubbing human, not fit to polish the boots of the true people.
entries.You speak without honor. Mine is the pow: You speak without honour. Mine is the power of our ancient Law; speak your name and give up your murder, or the Law will cast you forth. I am a witness!
entries.The masked ones must have raided this pl: The masked ones must have raided this place before. Damaging the castle would have made it harder for the peasants to rally a defence.
You have acted in honour. I am a witness.
entries.There is a camp of mages not far upriver: There is a camp of mages not far upriver. If they have not yet departed, they can help you. Travel westwards, to lands of the Northern Alliance. There you will be safe, and welcomed.
entries.You are our honored guests, and I will s: You are our honoured guests, and I will show you to the best quarters we have myself. Then I must see to my troop’s care. Lord Karrag will have speech with you on the morrow.
entries.Aye? Well, you’d know such things better: Aye? Well, you’d know such things better than I would, Loremaster. Our Karrag toiled for long years to recover the craft lore. He was elevated when our old lord fell in battle against the besieging orcs. Karrag himself was wounded nearly to death; none thought he would recover. But he leads us today, and his runelore has oft been the only shield between us and the orcs.
entries.I see it. There is something very wrong: I see it. There is something wrong here.
entries.All dwarves are kin, and must prevail ag: All dwarves are kin, and must prevail against orcs and humans and other dirt-grubbers. You can be part of the fist that smites them.
entries.We did not come to smite anyone, but to: We did not come to smite anyone, but to reopen contact and trade.
entries.And you have sealed your doom. Hundreds: And you have sealed your doom. Hundreds of dirt-grubbers have already died to weave a web of blood around the Hammer and the soul of the dwarves. You and your new friends will be the last sacrifices I require to bind the entire dwarvish race to my purpose. Take the Knalgans, and Dulcatulos too! TAKE THEM!
Then Karrag has fled to the under-levels. None but the masked ones — his inner circle — go there any more.
entries.It is Karrag’s doing—his will, and his d: It is Karrag’s doing — his will, and his dark magic. I think he has been casting glamours on all of you ever since he passed over.
entries.Your path forward ends here! Once the lo: Your path forwards ends here! Once the lord’s spell is complete, your souls will soon be chained to his will!
entries.The dirtgrubbers have come! Stop their a: The dirt-grubbers have come! Stop their advance!
entries.My lord, the dirtgrubbers have entered o: My lord, the dirt-grubbers have entered our sanctuary!
entries.Any enemy of my rule is no better than t: Any enemy of my rule is no better than the filthiest of dirt-grubbers. You no longer belong to the true people. You will become my slaves!
entries.No! No! No! Dirtgrubbers must die! The t: No! No! No! Dirt-grubbers must die! The true people must rule all!
entries.The way is sealed by the ancient runelor: The way is sealed by the ancient rune-lore of the Hammer. No amount of force can open these doors.
entries.HAHAHAHA! Yes, yes, YES! The rite of dea: HA HA HA HA! Yes, yes, YES! The rite of death is complete at last! Die, you filthy dirt-grubbers, die so that I may raise you again as my mindless slaves!
Dwarves of Kal Kartha, I speak the Law. Your house is cast down; you have harboured a great evil. Who now will take the burden of cleansing this holding of its taint?
entries.Arthritic fingers unable to loose the kn: Arthritic fingers unable to loose the knot that held tight its mouth, Ravan leaned forwards, muttering under his breath an arcane word of opening. Sparks leapt from his fingers—
entries.Outfitted in the strongest plate and mai: Outfitted in the strongest plate and mail of Knalgan forges, the Steelclads are the vanguard of dwarvish armies. They are renowned for their resilience in the heat of battle, and their mastery of both battle-axe and war-hammer make them imposing foes indeed. In the dark dreams of dwarvenkind, some conceal their faces behind riveted masks.
